JOB POSTING:
Data Analyst, Merchandising Analytics
Halvorsen Home Supply | Columbus, OH (hybrid, three days a week in our Polaris office)

About us
Halvorsen Home Supply is a regional home improvement retailer with 64 stores across Ohio, Indiana, Kentucky and western Pennsylvania, plus a growing online business. Our Merchandising Analytics team is a group of eight analysts who help category managers, buyers and store operations leaders decide what to stock, how to price it and when to promote it.

The role
We are hiring a Data Analyst to own weekly sales, margin and inventory reporting for two of our largest departments, building materials and seasonal. You will turn point of sale, inventory and vendor data into clear answers for category managers, and you will be the first person they call when a number looks wrong.

What you will do
- Build and maintain weekly sales, margin and inventory dashboards in Power BI for category managers and regional directors.
- Write SQL against our Snowflake data warehouse to answer ad hoc questions about product, store and promotion performance.
- Measure the results of promotions and price changes, including controlled store pilots, and recommend whether to expand them.
- Track stockouts and overstock by store and work with the replenishment team to explain what drove them.
- Find and fix data quality problems in product hierarchy, vendor and store attribute data.
- Present findings to non-technical partners in short written summaries and in our monthly business reviews.

What we are looking for
- Three or more years of experience in a data analyst, reporting analyst or similar role.
- Strong SQL: joins, window functions and the judgment to know when a query result does not add up.
- Advanced Excel and hands-on experience with a BI tool (Power BI preferred, Tableau or Looker welcome).
- A bachelor's degree in statistics, economics, mathematics, computer science or a related quantitative field.
- Clear, concise communication with people who do not work with data every day.

Nice to have
- Python or R for analysis and automation.
- Experience with retail, distribution or supply chain data.
- Familiarity with Snowflake or another cloud data warehouse.

What we offer
- Salary range of $72,000 to $88,000, plus an annual bonus.
- Medical, dental and vision coverage, a 401(k) with a 5 percent match and an employee discount.
- Fifteen days of paid time off in your first year, plus paid holidays.

APPLICATION:
David Ryan
Columbus, OH | (614) 555-0108 | david.ryan@gmail.com

SUMMARY
Sales and labor analyst for a 40-location restaurant group, after two years as a finance assistant at the same company. Updates the weekly sales forecast, maintains Power BI and Excel reports for operations directors and finance, and pulls data from the POS and scheduling systems with basic SQL. Has not worked with retail merchandise or inventory data beyond food cost tracking.

EXPERIENCE
Sales and Labor Analyst | Cobblestone Hospitality Group, Columbus, OH | Jan 2021 to Present
• Update the weekly sales forecast for 40 locations across four restaurant brands in Excel, using SQL Server pulls and seasonality factors set by the finance manager.
• Maintain the labor scheduling workbook that converts forecasted covers by daypart into recommended hours, and help general managers when the numbers look off.
• Pulled traffic, check average and item mix for a menu price pilot at six locations, and prepared the comparison tables used in the director's recommendation.
• Keep the Power BI sales and labor dashboard running, refreshed nightly from Toast POS and 7shifts exports, and pass larger change requests to the IT reporting contractor.
• Chase down weekly anomalies such as missing POS batches and gift card redemptions coded as sales, and log each fix with IT and accounting.
• Draft the sales section of the monthly operating review deck for the finance manager to edit.
• Update a monthly food cost variance sheet comparing theoretical to actual usage by location for the finance manager.
• Sized a third party delivery commission change for the finance manager by pulling order volume and average ticket by location, which fed into the rate discussion with the delivery partner.
• Answer ad hoc questions from brand leaders on daypart sales and discount usage, usually with a query and a short email the same week.
• Keep the POS menu item category list current when brands add or drop items.

Finance Assistant | Cobblestone Hospitality Group, Columbus, OH | Aug 2018 to Dec 2020
• Assembled the weekly flash report from 30 linked spreadsheets each Monday for the finance team.
• Reconciled daily sales deposits against POS totals for 40 locations and followed up on gaps with general managers.
• Supported reopening plans in 2020 with daily sales and staffing tracking as dining rooms moved through capacity limits.
• Tracked weekly overtime hours by location in Excel and sent a short exceptions list to area directors each Tuesday.
• Coded vendor invoices for food and paper costs and matched each one to delivery receipts.
• Prepared location profit and loss schedules for quarterly reviews with regional directors.
• Learned SQL by rewriting a few flash report tabs as queries, which became the start of the analyst role.

EDUCATION
Bachelor of Science in Statistics, The Ohio State University, 2018

SKILLS
SQL: SQL Server, Snowflake (read access), basic joins and aggregations
BI and spreadsheets: Power BI (report refresh, simple visuals), Excel (forecast models, data tables, macros)
Analysis: sales forecasting, labor modeling, pilot comparisons, food cost variance
Systems: Toast POS, 7shifts, Restaurant365

ADDITIONAL
• Volunteer at a Columbus food bank, maintaining the donation intake spreadsheet and the monthly pounds distributed report
